name: sidebar-playground
title: Sidebar playground
description: Interactive demo block: variant controls, peek layout, and animated shared sidebar trigger (Motion).

files.content:
import { Playground } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-playground"

export function SidebarPlaygroundDemo() {
  return (
    <Playground.Provider>
      <Playground.Shell>
        <Playground.Header />
        <Playground.Body>
          <Playground.Controls />
          <Playground.ActiveConfig />
        </Playground.Body>
      </Playground.Shell>
    </Playground.Provider>
  )
}

import { PlaygroundActiveConfig } from "./playground-active-config"
import { PlaygroundBody } from "./playground-body"
import { PlaygroundControls } from "./playground-controls"
import { PlaygroundProvider } from "./playground-config"
import { PlaygroundHeader } from "./playground-header"
import { PlaygroundShell } from "./playground-shell"

export { usePlayground } from "./playground-config"
export type {
  PlaygroundCollapsible,
  PlaygroundVariant,
} from "./playground-config"

export const Playground = {
  Provider: PlaygroundProvider,
  Shell: PlaygroundShell,
  Header: PlaygroundHeader,
  Body: PlaygroundBody,
  Controls: PlaygroundControls,
  ActiveConfig: PlaygroundActiveConfig,
}

import { LayoutGroup } from "motion/react"
import type { ReactNode } from "react"

import { SidebarProvider, TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar"

import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/blocks/sidebar-playground/app-sidebar"

import { usePlayground } from "./playground-config"
import { PlaygroundMainInset } from "./playground-main-inset"
import { PlaygroundMainStandard } from "./playground-main-standard"

export function PlaygroundShell({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { state, meta } = usePlayground()
  const Main =
    state.variant === "inset"
      ? PlaygroundMainInset
      : PlaygroundMainStandard

  return (
    <TooltipProvider>
      <LayoutGroup id="playground-sidebar-trigger">
        <SidebarProvider key={meta.providerKey}>
          <AppSidebar />
          <Main>{children}</Main>
        </SidebarProvider>
      </LayoutGroup>
    </TooltipProvider>
  )
}

docs: Render `<SidebarPlaygroundDemo />` from your app root (or route). Import `sidebar-playground.css` in your global CSS. Install the `motion` package. Wire `@source` for `components/blocks/sidebar-playground` and `components/ui`.
